### Jesus, Where Are You?
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-june-5-2023.html
Passage: John 11:40
Points:
- Heartache and unanswered prayers often tempt believers to feel abandoned by God.
- Jesus intentionally delayed His arrival because He had a larger purpose than immediate healing.
- Human perspective sees only current pain, whereas God perceives the redemptive finished product.
- Believing through disappointment enables Christians to witness God's glory bringing life from loss.

### Lazarus Resurrected
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lazarus-resurrected
Passage: John 11:39-40
Points:
- Christ's primary objective was to display divine glory rather than simply relieve earthly afflictions.
- Martha hesitated before the decaying tomb, but Jesus urged her to look for God's power.
- Jesus publicly thanked the Father so onlookers would know He was sent with divine authority.
- Christ's effectual command over the grave shows how God's Word imparts life during spiritual regeneration.
